exposure: Labor status at admission (early labor vs. active labor)
Different active labor diagnostic guidelines (Friedman, NICE, ACOG/SMFM)
outcome: Proportion of women admitted in early labor
cohort: Parous women with spontaneous labor onset who gave birth to a single, cephalic-presenting fetus at term gestation between 2006 and 2010 (n = 3,219)
finding: Parous women admitted in early labor were more likely to receive oxytocin augmentation and have a cesarean birth, regardless of the active labor diagnostic guideline used.
